title: COROS Training Load Ramp Above Baseline
app: COROS, Wahoo ELEMNT, TrainerRoad, Apple Fitness / HealthKit exports, Concept2 Logbook, Strava, Garmin Connect, and Zwift activity feeds via official APIs, FIT/CSV exports, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=coros:activity
| bin _time span=1w
| stats sum(training_load) as load, sum(distance_km) as distance_km by athlete _time
| streamstats window=4 current=f avg(load) as baseline by athlete
| where baseline>0 AND load>baseline*1.25 AND distance_km>20
| sort - load
description: Uses COROS activity exports telemetry to monitor weekly training load against the recent COROS baseline in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for overshoot weeks that often precede fatigue, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest COROS activity exports data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a weekly cadence.
visualization: Weekly load bar chart by athlete.
grandmaExplanation: It measures weekly training load against the recent COROS baseline so you can spot overshoot weeks that often precede fatigue before it becomes annoying.
